summary: My project tells the story of the Mars rovers that Once explored the red planet and sent vital information back to earth. Although their missions have ended and they no longer work their legacy is unforgettable.
details: I create this project to inspire kids and get them excited about these pioneering rovers. I animated NASA open data using capcut and edited canva.
